about: The asset library: open sound effects, music, 3D models (GLB), rigged and animated models, textures, HDRIs, pixel art, icons, fonts and motion that Flint and the agents can pull into a project. Only permissive licenses (CC0, MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, OFL-1.1, CC-BY-4.0 with credit); GPL, share-alike, non-commercial and no-license material is left out. Checked 2026-11-09. Every file added to a project gets a line in assets/CREDITS.md (source, author, license, link). 'how': built-in = made by TribeCode (CC0), npm = single files from a pinned npm package on jsDelivr, gltf = Khronos glTF sample models, polyhaven = the Poly Haven API, browse = a site you download from yourself (drop the files in Files).

packs.title: TribeCode sound effects
packs.summary: Retro game sounds made on the spot (no download): jump, coin, hit, explosion, power-up, laser, click, select, blip, hurt, pickup, door. Each comes as a small .wav; ask for a variation and Flint makes another.

packs.title: TribeCode pixel kit
packs.summary: Small crisp pixel sprites as SVG, in the TribeCode palette: hero, slime, coin, heart, gem, key, chest, lantern, flame, star, sword, potion, tree, cloud, door, block.

packs.title: TribeCode motion presets
packs.summary: One small CSS file of calm animations (fade-up, pop, float, wiggle, pulse, slide-in, spin, typewriter caret) with prefers-reduced-motion built in. Add a class, done.

packs.title: Lucide icons
packs.summary: 1,700+ clean line icons (24px, stroke). The default for apps and websites.

packs.title: Tabler icons
packs.summary: 5,000+ outline icons, the biggest free set. Good when Lucide doesn't have it.

packs.title: Phosphor icons
packs.summary: Friendly rounded icons in a regular weight (bold, fill and duotone exist in the same package).

packs.title: Heroicons
packs.summary: 300 polished outline icons from the makers of Tailwind CSS.

packs.title: Pixelarticons
packs.summary: Hundreds of 24px pixel icons (hearts, coins, arrows, UI). Perfect for game menus and HUDs.

packs.title: HackerNoon pixel icons
packs.summary: 1,400+ pixel-style icons in regular and solid.

packs.title: Twemoji (emoji as SVG)
packs.by: Twitter, Inc and other contributors (graphics); jdecked/twemoji (package, MIT)
packs.summary: Every emoji as a crisp SVG. The graphics need a credit line (CREDITS.md gets it automatically).

packs.title: Open fonts (Fontsource)
packs.by: each font's designers, packaged by Fontsource
packs.summary: Self-hosted Google Fonts. Flint copies the files and writes a fonts.css with @font-face.

packs.title: Khronos glTF sample models
packs.summary: Ready-to-load .glb models used to test every 3D engine. Fox, Rigged Figure and Rigged Simple carry skeletons and animations (walk, run).

models.name: Fox
models.license: CC0-1.0 (model) + CC-BY-4.0 (rigging and animation by tomkranis)

packs.title: Poly Haven
packs.summary: Free HDRIs (skies and lighting for 3D), PBR textures (wood, stone, metal) and realistic 3D models. Flint takes the 1k size so projects stay small.

sources.title: ArtCraft
sources.summary: Make your own art: compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D and pose characters, then drop the results into Files or the inspiration board.

sources.title: Kenney
sources.summary: Thousands of game assets in matching styles: 2D and pixel tilesets, 3D kits, UI packs, sound effects and jingles. Download a pack, drop it in Files.

sources.title: Quaternius
sources.summary: Low-poly 3D packs (nature, dungeon, sci-fi, animals) and the Universal Animation Library: 120+ rigged character animations.

sources.title: KayKit by Kay Lousberg
sources.summary: Chunky, colorful 3D characters, dungeons and city kits, rigged and animated, ready for three.js and Godot.

sources.title: OpenGameArt (CC0 filter)
sources.summary: A huge community library. Use the CC0 filter: other licenses there (GPL, CC-BY-SA) aren't allowed in TribeCode starters.

sources.title: ambientCG
sources.summary: PBR materials, HDRIs and decals, all public domain.

sources.title: Freesound (CC0 filter)
sources.summary: Real recorded sounds (rain, footsteps, crowds). Filter to Creative Commons 0; a free account downloads.

sources.title: glTF Sample Assets browser
sources.summary: Search every Khronos sample model by tag; the CC0 and CC-BY ones are fine to use with credit.

libraries.title: ZzFX
libraries.summary: A tiny sound-effect synth for games (one function call per sound).

libraries.title: Howler.js
libraries.summary: Play sounds and music reliably in every browser.

libraries.title: Tone.js
libraries.summary: Make music in the browser: synths, loops, sequencers.

libraries.title: three.js
libraries.summary: The 3D library: load .glb models, play their animations (AnimationMixer), light them with an HDRI.

libraries.title: <model-viewer>
libraries.summary: Show a .glb on a web page with one tag: orbit, AR, animations.

libraries.title: Rive runtimes
libraries.summary: Interactive 2D bone animations. The runtime is MIT; check each .riv file's own license.

libraries.title: Motion
libraries.summary: Smooth, spring-based animation for the web.

libraries.title: Anime.js
libraries.summary: Timeline animations for CSS, SVG and canvas.

libraries.title: Lottie (lottie-web)
libraries.summary: Plays Lottie JSON animations. The player is MIT; many free Lottie files use the Lottie Simple License, which isn't open source, so check each file.

libraries.title: tsParticles
libraries.summary: Confetti, snow, fireflies and particle backgrounds.

libraries.title: pixelfx
libraries.summary: 244 pixel effects (fire, magic, hits) as sprite sheets.

libraries.title: Pico CSS
libraries.summary: Good-looking plain HTML with one stylesheet, no classes needed.

libraries.title: daisyUI
libraries.summary: Tailwind components (buttons, cards, navbars) with themes.

libraries.title: Flowbite
libraries.summary: Tailwind components with the JavaScript for menus, modals and tabs.

libraries.title: Open Props
libraries.summary: Ready design tokens: colors, sizes, shadows, easings as CSS variables.

libraries.title: NES.css
libraries.summary: An 8-bit look for buttons, dialogs and boxes.

left_out.title: Mixamo
left_out.why: free to use in your own work but not an open license, and the files can't be redistributed in a repo

left_out.title: GSAP
left_out.why: free, but under its own 'Standard no charge' license, not an open-source license

left_out.title: LottieFiles free animations
left_out.why: the Lottie Simple License isn't an open-source license; the players are MIT and listed

left_out.title: Sonniss GDC bundles
left_out.why: royalty-free but not openly licensed; can't go into public repos

left_out.title: Duck, BrainStem, Sponza and other Khronos samples with custom licenses
left_out.why: SCEA, Poser EULA and Cryengine licenses aren't open
